text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am once again in your debt, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for your kind words the<n>other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my path is clear and<n>my confidence
restored.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No longer am I blind to my own<n>failings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, is there any race more fitting<n>than this to
mark the Emperor's<n>rebirth?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today, a new name will join the<n>legends who have
raced this track...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The name of Symboli Rudolf, the<n>Emperor!
